l13.label: Independent elective
l13.requires: An L01 project and model. This module prepares Search, embeddings, and an index, which also provide the foundation for L14.

l14.label: Prerequisites required
l14.requires: The Search service and index from L13, or equivalent administrator-provided resources. Required only for the optional live Hosted deployment in L22.

l15.label: Independent elective
l15.requires: A basic project/model, ownership receipt, and separate .venv-advanced environment. Check the chosen pattern's TPM and request limit in L02 first. Neither L14 Hosted deployment nor an A2A connection is required.

l16.label: Independent elective
l16.requires: A basic project, chat and embedding deployments, and access to supported Memory features. No other advanced module is required.

l17.label: Separate feature paths
l17.requires: A routine can run independently with the server-side prompt agent from L05. The long-running Hosted path requires L14.

l21.label: Independent elective
l21.requires: Use Python for the local access/cache repair, then complete the synthetic design. Actual access/network inspection needs read permissions; changes require an administrator and separate approval.

l22.label: Run after source setup
l22.requires: Use L01's local environment and sources for synthetic CI failure/repair and release/rollback design. L14 is needed only for optional live Hosted deployment; repeated evaluation and Optimizer are not required.
